source_text: Juniper Grove needs a six-page responsive website and analytics setup in twelve weeks. Budget: $18,000–$28,000. We can supply approved photography and a draft sitemap. Please address Avery Lee at avery@juniper-grove.example.com.

Tern & Tide would like a new shop by June, though the board note says October. We have not decided how many products will launch. We may consider inventory sync later; it is not requested for this phase.

Morrow Pantry asks for a brand identity and guidelines, plus a 15% discount. The team might later want packaging concepts but has not approved that scope. We can supply interview notes and need a quote before the September planning meeting.
